primary.desc: Hold to draw, let go to loose. 0.6s Empowered: 30 damage, lands at the cursor (up to 12m). 1.15s Supercharged: 60 damage, flies past the cursor to 16m. Let go right as a stage comes up and your next draw is 60% faster; hold 0.5s past Supercharged and the arrow is overdrawn (half damage). Let go early for 15 at the cursor. You walk slower while drawing.
